reference: Stored ANUGA sequences from the v2 dataset

metric_definitions.depth_and_momentum: MAE, RMSE, and bias over all grid cells
metric_definitions.wet_depth_mean_relative_error_pct: Mean absolute relative depth error on ANUGA cells with depth >= wet threshold
metric_definitions.wet_area_csi: Intersection over union at the wet threshold
metric_definitions.velocity: u, v, vector, and speed MAE where both ANUGA and ConvLSTM depths meet the wet threshold
metric_definitions.water_volume_relative_error_pct: Absolute difference in total depth-integrated volume divided by ANUGA volume
metric_definitions.aggregation: Metrics are calculated per scenario, then averaged equally across validation scenarios
